measurements.height_status: Estimated. No measured vertical source found. Purdue's current emergency plan says three stories; GIS fields NUM_LEVELS and CountOfFlo are 4, while F04 is 0. GIS Extrution=27 has no documented units and was not treated as a measured height.
measurements.roof_status: Low, shallow roof edge modeled from the official exterior photo; hidden roof geometry is unverified.

geometry_edits: Replaced the original 24-vertex, 32-face rectangular massing block with the 14-vertex Purdue feature 235 structural wall outline.
Rebuilt a three-story red-brick facade with evenly spaced sash windows, pale stone sills/lintels and horizontal floor bands guided by the official photo.
Added a south-facing paired entrance, four-column limestone portico, entablature, and approach steps guided by the official photo.
Added a shallow dark roof plane and overhanging cornice; roof details remain visual estimates.
Preserved the existing asset file, stable ID, object name, exported collection, identity transform, and campus coordinate frame.
uncertainties: GIS footprint positional and dimensional accuracy is unpublished; it is not a survey.
Purdue's Emergency Plan describes three stories while GIS level count fields indicate four; the model follows the current BEP and exterior photograph, and treats the GIS count conflict as unresolved.
Wall height and floor spacing are visual/story-count estimates; GIS Extrution=27 is not used because its units and meaning are undocumented.
One oblique photo cannot verify all facade elevations, rear additions, precise window spacing, roof pitch, or materials on every side.
Primary entrance orientation toward the south frontage is inferred from address/photo context; no plan or compass-tagged elevation was found.

independent_grade.summary: Independent evaluator reopened the saved asset and verified all 14 structural footprint edges against Purdue GIS feature 235, with maximum edge error 0.0000143 m. Position/orientation/plan dimensions received full credit; height/floors/roof form received 1.25/2 and facade received 1.5/2.
limitations: The 11.95 m roof elevation and 3.8 m floor spacing are estimates; no measured elevation or floor-height source is available.
The GIS floor-count fields indicate four while the Purdue emergency plan says three stories; the discrepancy remains unresolved.
The reference photo shows only one oblique frontage; other elevations and precise facade dimensions remain unverified.
